settings.title: [FR] System Configuration
settings.description: [FR] Manage local-first engine parameters and hardware links.

settings.jitsiBaaDesc2: [FR]  and cannot be toggled off. Telehealth calls route

settings.highContrastDesc: [FR] Force maximum contrast for field readability.
settings.showTickerDesc: [FR] Scrolling status bar at the top of the app.

settings.killSwitchDesc: [FR] Designate a USB token. If it is removed while armed, all vault keys are dropped from memory (references cleared; reclaimed by the runtime).
settings.noDevicesPrefix: [FR] No devices listed yet. Plug in your token and click
settings.backupDesc: [FR] Exports encrypted ciphertext only, HMAC-signed with your passphrase. Restore verifies the signature and refuses tampered files.
settings.auditLogDesc: [FR] Hash-chained record of every vault access (metadata only — no PHI). Editing or deleting any past entry breaks the chain.
settings.tamperingDetectedPrefix: [FR] ✗ TAMPERING DETECTED — chain breaks at entry #
settings.nukeDesc: [FR] Irreversibly delete all local storage and keys.
